jobs.title: AI Developer & Automation Apprentice
jobs.description:
**Are you excited by AI and curious about how technology can transform the way businesses work?**

**We’re looking for an AI Developer & Automation Apprentice to join our AI implementation programme and help shape the future of AI across the firm.**

This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in AI development, automation, business analysis, process improvement and change management while working on real projects that deliver meaningful business impact.

You'll work alongside experienced developers, technical specialists and business stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI and automation can improve the way we work. You’ll then help design, build, test and implement solutions, as well as supporting colleagues to adopt and get the most from new technology.

Rawlinson & Hunter is a leading international firm of Chartered Accountants, providing specialist accounting, taxation and advisory services to high-net-worth individuals, families and businesses. Technology has been an important part of the firm's development for more than 20 years, and we have an established in-house IT team comprising developers, cloud specialists, support professionals and trainers.

**What you’ll be doing:**

You'll be involved throughout the lifecycle of AI and automation projects, working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders across the firm.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Supporting requirements gathering, process mapping and identifying opportunities for AI and automation.
* Assisting with the design and development of AI applications, agents, workflows and automation solutions.
* Building and refining solutions using AI development tools, coding assistants and automation platforms.
* Testing AI solutions to ensure they are accurate, reliable, secure and fit for purpose.
* Supporting the deployment, documentation and rollout of new AI-powered solutions.
* Creating user guides and training materials and supporting colleagues with the adoption of new technology.
* Gathering user feedback and helping identify opportunities for improvement.

**What we’re looking for:**

We're looking for someone curious about technology, who enjoys solving problems and is excited by the potential of AI.

You may have developed your experience through education, personal projects, online learning, previous employment or simply experimenting with technology in your own time.

We're looking for candidates who:

* Have a strong interest in AI, software development and emerging technologies.
* Have some programming experience or willingness to develop programming skills with languages such as Python, JavaScript, C#, TypeScript or SQL.
* Enjoy analysing problems and finding ways to improve processes.
* Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Can work confidently with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
* Are organised, reliable and detail-oriented.
* Are eager to learn and develop new technical skills.
* Can work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

Experience with AI tools, coding assistants, workflow automation, APIs, Agile, Jira or the Microsoft technology stack would be beneficial, but **is not essential**.

**Entry requirements:**

* Level 3 Qualification (Apprenticeship/A Levels/BTEC etc.)
* OR equivalent work experience (typically 2 years in a relevant role)  
  **AND**
* 5 x GCSE’s including English & Maths at Grade 4 (C) or above.

**Working hours:** 37.5 hours per week (Monday to Friday, 9am - 5pm with 30 minutes lunch break)

**What we offer:**

* 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
* Discretionary annual bonus review.
* Internal coaching, professional development and training opportunities.
* Company pension scheme.
* Private medical insurance.
* Free on-site gym (Leatherhead office).
* Discounted gym memberships.
* Cycle to Work scheme.
* Team social events (e.g. Christmas and summer parties).

**Future prospects:**

90% of QA apprentices secure permanent employment after completing: this is 20% higher than the national average.

**About QA:**

Our apprenticeships are the perfect way to gain new skills, earn while you learn, and launch yourself into an exciting future. With over 50,000 successful apprenticeship graduates, we're a top 50 training provider, dedicated to helping you succeed.

**Interested? Apply now!**

jobs.title: Senior Developer
jobs.description:
**Senior Developer**  
**Position Overview**  
We are looking for a Senior Developer to join our Consulting business.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to design, build and deliver secure, scalable .Net applications, and Azure-based solutions for client projects, translating business requirements into effective technical outcomes.

You will also lead in stakeholder engagements and coordinate technical strategy in this space with team members.

This is a senior role where you will be given the platform to showcase your expertise and knowledge.

**Salary & Benefits**

The budgeted salary for this role is between **£70,000 to £80,000 a year**, depending on experience.

**Click here** for the list of benefits.

**Hybrid working**

We recognise the benefits that remote and flexible working brings.

We operate a hybrid working policy that allows our employees to balance time in the office and time from home. Each team within our organisation can decide how to implement this policy. If you have any questions after applying, please reach out to our recruitment team.  
  
**Responsibilities**  
Some of your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

* **Designing, developing, and supporting** secure, scalable **.NET / Azure solutions**
* **Working with clients and stakeholders** to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions
* **Building and maintaining Azure PaaS services**, integrations, and APIs
* **Managing CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code** using Azure DevOps, GitHub, Terraform, and/or Bicep
* **Producing technical documentation, estimates, and delivery artefacts** to support project outcomes
* **Collaborate within an agile team**, while mentoring others and contributing to continuous improvement

**What Success Looks Like**

* **Quickly add value** on a key client engagement, building strong relationships with senior stakeholders of varying technical backgrounds and helping shape strategic goals and outcomes.
* **Collaborate effectively** as part of an agile team, contributing to the design and delivery of **Azure solutions and architecture**.
* **Produce clear, high-quality** technical documentation, estimates, and implementation deliverables that align with project objectives and expectations.
* **Communicate confidently** in client-facing settings, translating business requirements into **secure, scalable, and effective technical solutions**.

**Qualifications & Experience**

The right candidate for this role will have:

* Strong **Microsoft .NET / C# development** expertise, delivering projects end-to-end
* Advanced **Azure DevOps and/or GitHub** skills, including **CI/CD pipelines / GitHub Actions**
* Proven experience with the **Microsoft Azure PaaS ecosystem**, including **Azure Functions, Storage, Logic Apps, APIs, managed identities, integration patterns, and secure Entra-based solutions**
* Experience with **infrastructure as code** using **Terraform and/or Bicep** for repeatable Azure deployments
* Strong **communication, documentation, estimation, and client-facing** skills, with experience working in **agile delivery environments**
* A collaborative team player who can **lead by example, mentor others, and guide delivery teams**

Please note, we may require you to obtain security clearance (SC) in the future, so for that reason we will ask you if you are a British passport holder with 5 years residency in the UK on the application form.

**About Us:**  
We are the tech company with people at heart.

At Advania, we believe in empowering people to create sustainable value through the clever use of technology. As one of Microsoft's leading partners in the UK, specialising in Azure, Security, Dynamics 365, and Microsoft 365, we have a proven track record of success in delivering transformational IT services.

**Our Selection Process:**

We are committed to ensuring an equitable experience for all candidates, regardless of race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

Please do let us know if you’ll need any reasonable adjustments as part of the selection process by highlighting these on your application form.

As part of our commitment to our clients we will need to carry out background checks, including a criminal record check, for all offers of employment. If you have any unspent criminal convictions or questions about the screening process, please notify your recruiter once the application has been submitted.

**#LI-Hybrid**

jobs.title: Civil Engineer (Development)
jobs.description:
**Civils Engineer (Development)**

**Location** - Prenton offices, Wirral (with site visits across SP Manweb)

**Salary + benefits** - £45,400 - £56,750 with annual review, comprehensive pension scheme (company doubles your contribution up to 10%), plus extensive benefits package

**Closing date** - Monday 26th October

  
  

**Help us create a better future, quicker**

  

Our industry is experiencing unprecedented transformation as we work towards Net Zero. SP Energy Networks is delivering multiple projects simultaneously, overhauling our network to enhance resilience and secure electricity supply for our communities' economic growth. As a Civils Engineer (Development), you will play a vital role in this transformation by undertaking site inspections of substation construction projects from 11kV to 33kV. You will ensure works are carried out according to approved construction plans, SPEN building specifications, and best practice standards. Using your professional judgement and technical expertise, you will provide design and construction guidance to internal Design functions and external Framework Contractors. This is an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact on critical infrastructure that powers communities across the North West of England.

  
  

**What you'll be doing**

  

* Conduct regular inspections of building work at various stages of completion, measuring and sampling building materials to verify their quality meets required standards
* Confirm that construction work aligns with approved plans and SPEN specifications, while providing technical design assistance to SPM Design, customer engagement teams, and other teams during project design phases
* Become well-versed in the SPEN Civil specification for Primary Substation Civil works, reviewing end-of-project returns including as-built documentation to ensure civil works are properly recorded within SPEN corporate systems
* Review financial applications made via framework arrangements to ensure they align with works delivered on site
* Maintain quality and consistency of technical and construction output across all projects
* Build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders and customers on behalf of ScottishPower, facilitating delivery of strategic goals
* Promote an exemplary safety culture, ensuring all safety legislation is implemented and delivered through activities and incorporated into project designs
* Contribute to team development by mentoring and training less experienced team members, graduates, and trainees, helping to build capability across the organization
* Manage a 6-month work bank of site inspections in coordination with design teams, overseeing civil works for Primary Projects in the delivery phase up to and including 33kV, typically valued at approximately £25m per annum
  

  

**What you'll bring**

  

* NVQ, HND, or bachelor's qualification in a construction-related subject such as building surveying, civil engineering, structural engineering, or construction management
* Membership of a relevant professional body such as the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RICS), the Chartered Association of Building Engineers (CABE), or the Chartered Institute of Building (CIOB) is highly valued
* Solid knowledge of structural and civil engineering design approaches and material properties
* Practical familiarity with construction methods and experience across common forms of construction
* Capability to interpret construction drawings with meticulous attention to detail
* Knowledge of building regulations, construction processes, legislation, and requirements
* 5 years or more of relevant experience, with great attention to detail and pride in design quality
* Full clean driving licence (required)
* Experience working in the electrical industry is desirable though not essential
* Strong numeracy and computer literacy skills
* Effective communication capabilities that enable you to provide clear advice and guidance
* Effective problem-solving skills and the capability to work well within a team environment
* Capacity to meet deadlines consistently
* Negotiation skills and the confidence to provide professional advice and guidance to colleagues and contractors
* Availability to travel as required across the region to fulfill site inspection accountabilities
  

  

**What's in it for you**

  

As well as an attractive salary which is reviewed annually, you can also enjoy a number of other benefits. With our pension scheme, we'll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%.

At ScottishPower, we believe it's the little things we do in life that make a big difference. From helping you look after your family's wellbeing, save for your future and take personal steps for climate action - our benefits are designed to help you do just that - so that you have everything you need to take care of your world - today and tomorrow. That's why our benefits include:

* 36 days annual leave
* Holiday Purchase - perfect your work/life balance with extra annual leave
* Equity Plans
* Payroll Giving and Charity Matched Funding
* Technology Vouchers - save more and spread the cost of your technology purchases
* Electric Vehicle Schemes - to help you transition to green/clean driving
* Cycle to Work scheme and Public Transport Season Ticket Loans
* Healthcare benefit options including: Dental Insurance, Private Medical Insurance, Health Cash Plan and annual Health Assessments
* Life Assurance (4x salary)
* Access to Savesmart financial wellbeing assistance
* Plus shopping, leisure, restaurant and gym discounts, and unique employee deals on travel insurance and more
  

  

**Why SP Energy Networks**

  

SP Energy Networks is part of the Iberdrola Group, one of the world's largest integrated utility companies and a world leader in wind energy. We keep electricity flowing to homes and businesses through Central and Southern Scotland, North Wales and in the North West of England. We operate over 4000km of cables and lines that make-up the transmission network - connecting infrastructure like wind farms into the electricity system. It's a role that puts us right at the heart of Scotland's ambition to be Net Zero by 2044. And we're taking it very seriously. We're investing >£5.5 billion into our transmission network, directly supporting the rapid growth needed in renewable energy. With diverse opportunities across our businesses and a commitment to invest in our own internal talent, ScottishPower can offer people real career opportunities that meet personal and professional goals, in a global organisation.

  
  

Inclusion, diversity, and a social purpose are at the heart of everything we do. Together with our values, they bring us together into a stronger, more sustainable business with direct links to the communities we serve. It takes all kinds of people to build a large-scale business like ours, so whatever your background, you'll fit right in.

  
  

We are committed to providing reasonable support or adjustments in our recruiting processes for candidates with disabilities, long term conditions, mental health conditions, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy-related support. If you need support, please reach out to careers@scottishpower.com .

**Mobility**

Please note that any applicant who is not a citizen of the country of the vacancy will be subject to compliance with the applicable immigration requirements to legally work in that country. If/when required, the Company will support the employee with the necessary Immigration requirements.

**I** **MPORTANT**

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description:
Working as part of the Software Development team the post holder will be a software development specialist, with experience of developing and implementing technical software solutions to meet business requirements and support the organisation in the achievement of its strategic objectives. The software development team develop bespoke applications to support EEC where no ‘off the shelf’ solutions exist.
  
  
The post holder will ensure that projects produce the required deliverables within the defined quality, time and cost constraints and facilitate full realisation of benefits defined in the associated business cases which they may help develop. This will be achieved by adherence to relevant software development methodology and best practice within the profession.
  
  
The post holder will establish productive working relationships with colleagues within the organisation at all to facilitate the successful delivery of software solutions. The Senior Software Developer will be proficient with modern software development methodologies. They will also be proficient with version control.
  
  
In addition to software development the post holder is also expected to provide support for changes and development for the suite of applications delivered by the development team as and when appropriate.
  
  
Please note; Interviews will be Face-2-Face.
  
  
"(Should we receive a high number of applications we reserve the right to close this vacancy at any point after 09/10/2026)"
  
  
Expertise and a proven track record in system design, application architecture, programming, procedural, declarative or structured querying programming language.
  
  
Technical knowledge of MS SQL relational databases, database design and the Structured Query Language.
  
  
Proven experience using Visual Studio to write software code and produce elegant, robust and maintainable software applications.
  
  
Proven experience using current C# ASP.NET versions 8 and above
  
  
A command of the principles of good software design using the principles of SOLID and object-oriented programming.
  
  
Practical experience using source control systems (i.e. Git).
  
  
Rated ‘Outstanding’ by the Care Quality Commission, we are proud to provide high quality innovative services across most of the east of England that enable people to receive care closer to home and live healthier lives.
  
  
There’s one reason why our services are outstanding – and that’s our amazing staff who, for the seventh year running, rated us incredibly highly in the national staff survey.
  
  
If you share our passion for innovative and high-quality care delivery, then please submit your application and join us on our exciting journey as a leading-edge specialist community provider. All are welcome to apply and our promise to you is a culture which prioritises staff engagement and development.
  
  
Please be aware that East of England Community Health and Care NHS Trust will never ask applicants to pay fees at any stage of the recruitment process, including job applications, sponsorship arrangements, or employment offers. All recruitment communications and job applications should only be made through our official careers website and published contact details.
  
  
If you receive a suspicious job offer or recruitment-related communication, do not make any payments, share personal information, or provide identity documents. We encourage you to report the matter to your local police or relevant law enforcement agency. Any concerns relating to potential recruitment fraud should also be reported to our Local Counter Fraud Specialist (LCFS) as soon as possible.
  
  
**Duties/Responsibilities:****The post holder must be able to demonstrate:**  
Expertise and a proven track record in system design, application architecture, programming, procedural, declarative or structured querying programming language.
  
  
Technical knowledge of MS SQL relational databases, database design and the Structured Query Language.
  
  
Proven experience using Visual Studio to write software code and produce elegant, robust and maintainable software applications.
  
  
Proven experience using current C# ASP.NET versions 8 and above
  
  
A command of the principles of good software design using the principles of SOLID and object-oriented programming.
  
  
Practical experience using source control systems (i.e. Git).
  
  
Undertake responsibility for own code and review others code to ensure quality and adherence to our software standards.
  
  
Engage and liaise with end users and project stakeholders (project managers/BAs) to identify system and information requirements.
  
  
Discuss progress and notify senior staff of impediments during regular team meetings.
  
  
Discuss ideas with colleagues and review tasks and priorities in collaboration with other team members and senior staff.
  
  
Contribute ideas on how the team can become more effective.
  
  
Actively listen to the advice and guidance of colleagues and tune behaviour accordingly – for example listen to suggestions from colleagues during pair programming sessions and code reviews.
  
  
Speak confidently to groups of users or peers; Demonstrating ideas, concepts and software and answering questions.
  
  
Discuss ideas with their line manager on ways to improve their performance and advance personal development - at personal development reviews, for example.
  
  
Continual upgrading of skills to reflect rapid changes in technology. This is achieved through formal training; informal skills transfer and self-tuition.
  
  
Influence and participate in defining standards for development through research and implementation of new technologies and solutions.
  
  
Plan own workload and activities over short to medium periods to meet project deadlines and provide user support, this often involves multiple complex projects and support incidents.
  
  
Prioritise own workload to resolve conflicts between project and support tasks which involves re-planning; escalating to the Software Development Manager when required.
  
  
Collaborate with key stakeholders to identify service needs and to enable the realisation of business value.
  
  
Able to proactively identify opportunities to improve a service for stakeholders.
  
The post holder must be familiar with Windows PC and server operating systems.
  
**The post holder shall be expected to:** -
  
  
Follow good development practice by adhering to the organisation’s conventions for checking software code into source control systems.
  
  
Contribute to the production of suitable quality control records (such as problem or change records) for application and system software changes.
  
  
Knowledge share, support and mentor team members in ensuring that software applications have full patch and version control in place and that the organisation has a comprehensive record of all these amendments.
  
  
Implement system software upgrades as and when required.
  
  
Communication
  
  
Required to communicate with staff, patients and stakeholders at all levels from different disciplines.
  
  
Represent the department (at the request of the Software Development Manager) internally and externally at multi-disciplinary working groups / meetings and co-ordinate information responses.
  
  
Will be required to communicate highly complex technical advice in a non-technical way so the end user can understand.
  
  
Receive and interpret highly complex information from a variety of sources.
  
  
Excellent communication skills both written and verbal.
  
  
Human Resources
  
  
To participate in the appraisal process for EEC NHS Trust and take responsibility for working with line manager to identify an appropriate personal development plan.
  
  
To knowledge share and support other colleagues/teams or services going through change.
  
  
To maintain own professional development and requirement to take part in appraisal and Knowledge and Skills Framework (KSF) process.
  
  
Responsibility for Financial & Physical Resources
  
  
Responsible for the provision of technical solutions in the delivery and maintenance of a trust wide web solutions and for IT assets.
  
  
Research & Development Activity
  
  
Required to undertake R&D activity on a regular basis, once a month or more.
  
  
R&D activity is a major job requirement, at least 20% of the working
  
  
Clinical and Practice Governance
  
  
Observe and maintain strict confidentiality with regards to any patient/family/staff/records and information in line with the requirements of the Data Protection Act.
  
  
Any data that is taken/shared as part of a phone call or transported, faxed or transferred electronically must be undertaken with regard to EEC Information Governance and Information Security policies.
  
  
The post holder must adhere to EEC risk assessment and risk management processes
  
  
The post holder must adhere to infection control policies and procedures
  
  
Undertake mandatory training and any other training relevant to the role as required by EEC .
  
  
The post holder must participate in clinical and other audits as required.
  
  
The post holder is required to participate in relevant emergency preparedness process for their team.
  
  
**Working conditions:**  
Flexibility and resilience is required due to working in a dynamic and fast paced team with competing priorities.
  
  
The post holder will be expected to be able to meet the flexible working requirements of the role. Ability to work remotely or from hot desk facilities at different sites is essential.
  
  
General
  
The post holder must at all times carry out his/her duties with regard to East of England Community Health and Care NHS Trust Equal Opportunities Policy.
  
  
To be aware of the responsibilities of all employees to maintain a safe and healthy environment for patients, visitors and staff.
  
  
All post holders must adhere to the code of conduct on confidentiality and be aware of and adhere to all EEC policies and procedures.
  
  
This job description is intended only as a guide to the range of duties involved. The post holder will need to be flexible and adaptable in order to respond to other duties that may be required from time to time and the changes and developments within EEC.
